premises.text: Most commerce is still offline, but brands lack control of in-store execution while collaboration with retailers relies on calls, emails, and costly visits
premises.evidence_span: Brands and retailers are still relying on multiple phone calls and emails and very expensive and inefficient store visits

premises.text: Ubique is a collaboration platform so brands monitor globally, retailers improve execution remotely, and store employees focus on what matters
premises.evidence_span: Brands monitor their operations globally, retailers improve their execution remotely, and in-store employees can focus on what really matters

premises.text: Brands run campaigns with configurable data collection and can alternatively use a 50,000-consumer crowdsourcing community
premises.evidence_span: she can decide to use our crowdsourcing community of 50,000 consumers to collect the data on her behalf

premises.text: In-store staff complete tasks with training video, barcode stock updates, photo confirmation, and real-time object detection for facings
premises.evidence_span: Ubique uses real-time object detection to automate continuous products

premises.text: Combining sales data with merchandising info yields previously unavailable insights and live-chat retailer notifications
premises.evidence_span: By combining sales data with merchandising info, she has now insights that were never available before

premises.text: SaaS pricing is charged per user per company
premises.evidence_span: SaaS business model where we charge on a per-user, per-company basis

domains.name: campaign execution and shelf intelligence platform

value.text: Improve in-store execution collaboration so brands and retailers raise sales and merchandising ROI
value.evidence_span: We've improved field efficiency. We've maximized the merchandising return on investment
